roster_type.description: custom = manually built list; club_sync = linked to a club and optionally auto-synced.

club_id.description: Linked club id when roster_type = club_sync.

sync_enabled.description: When true, the roster is kept in sync with the club's current member list.

members.description: JSON array of member objects: { id, callsign, name, location, station_type, notes, club_role, membership_status, source }.
